intro.h2: Plan every detail on screen before the first wall comes down
paragraphs: Majestic Home Solutions is a family-owned remodeling contractor in Sterling Heights that has worked on Southeast Michigan homes since 1995. Many of its Google reviews mention finished basements, and the same crew takes on kitchens and bathrooms, from tear-out to the last piece of trim.

What sets the process apart is how much gets settled up front. Design meetings happen over Zoom at a time that suits you, and an optional Design Agreement buys extra hours with the design team for 3D renderings in Chief Architect and material picks. If you move ahead, that fee is applied to your project total.

services.h2: A remodeling contractor in Sterling Heights for basements, kitchens and baths

items.name: Basement finishing
items.blurb: Turn bare concrete into a home office, guest room, theater, gym, play space, extra bathroom or bar. Published packages start at $65,000 for 750 to 850 square feet, and add-ons such as a wet bar or a full bathroom are priced on the same page.

image.alt: Finished basement in Troy, MI with a shuffleboard table, a bar with seating and an open lounge area

items.name: Kitchen remodeling
items.blurb: Stock or custom cabinets, countertops, backsplash, lighting and appliance installs, planned around your budget. Published kitchen packages run $35,000, $45,000 and $55,000 for small to large kitchens that keep the existing floor, with more layout change allowed at each level.

image.alt: Remodeled kitchen with navy lower cabinets and island, white upper cabinets, glass pendant lights and a stainless range hood

items.name: Bathroom remodeling
items.blurb: Primary suites and guest baths with custom marble, mosaic or ceramic tile, new vanities and options like heated floors, towel warmers and rain shower heads. Full bathroom packages for a standard 5 by 9 room are listed at $10,000, $12,000 and $15,000, before fixture and tile material.

image.alt: Clinton Township primary bathroom remodel with a dark double vanity, white counter, two framed mirrors and vanity light bars

items.name: Custom bars and built-ins
items.blurb: Wet bars, dry bars, entertainment centers and built-in cabinets are a regular part of Majestic basements. One Auburn Hills family has worked with the company for over 20 years and recently updated an entertainment center the team built for them long ago.

image.alt: Rochester Hills basement bar with dark cabinets, a stone-look counter, stacked stone wall and pendant lights

why_choose_us.h2: Reasons Macomb and Oakland homeowners hire Majestic

items.title: An 18-month labor warranty
items.text: Majestic offers an 18-month warranty on all of its labor. If something comes up after the job, you call the office and the team takes care of it.

items.title: Prices in writing, no hidden costs
items.text: Proposals break out every material and labor cost, and the company publishes package pricing for basements, kitchens and baths so you can budget before the first meeting.

items.title: Calls returned within one business day
items.text: Communication is guaranteed: calls and emails are returned within 1 business day or sooner, and BuilderTrend daily logs show progress between your updates.

items.title: Proof everyone got paid
items.text: At final payment you receive a full waiver of lien, which shows that every subcontractor and supplier on your project has been paid in full.

about.h2: Founded by craftsman Zayne Roumaya in 1995
about.text: Zayne Roumaya, an experienced craftsman, founded the company as “Majestic” in 1995, working on carpentry, deck design and remodeled basements, kitchens and baths. In 2005 it was reorganized into the family-owned Majestic Home Solutions, LLC, and its focus moved toward high-end design for basement finishing, kitchen remodels and bath refurbishments. Homeowners still meet Zayne on the job: Andre A. named him and Chris in his review after his basement was finished in early 2024. Every new hire passes a background check and skills evaluation, and licensed staff take continuing education courses to stay current on code.

process.h2: Dreaming to post-construction in five steps

steps.title: Dreaming
steps.text: At the first consultation you share inspiration photos, needs and budget while the team takes preliminary measurements and photos for your project file.

steps.title: Designing
steps.text: You review a preliminary plan and estimate, then sign a design agreement or contract. The agreement adds design hours for Chief Architect 3D renderings and selections.

steps.title: Pre-construction
steps.text: You get a BuilderTrend account for selections, schedules, change orders and daily logs, and every material is ordered and on site before work starts.

steps.title: Construction
steps.text: Each trade starts with a walk-through, crews follow detailed checklists, and a punch list walkthrough happens before the final payment is collected.

steps.title: Post-construction
steps.text: Your 18-month limited warranty begins, and the team comes back to photograph the finished space and talk through how the project went.

faq.h2: What to know before you finish a basement or remodel

items.q: How much does a finished basement cost?
items.a: Majestic publishes three packages for qualifying homes built in 1985 or later: Bronze at $65,000 for 750 to 850 square feet, Silver at $85,000 for 850 to 1,000 square feet, and Gold at $100,000 for 1,000 to 1,100 square feet. Upgrades such as a wet bar, full bathroom or extra room are priced separately.

It is an optional first step that covers a virtual design consultation, material selections and renderings of your space, with a set number of revisions. Fees start at a $2,500 minimum for projects under $100,000 and rise with project size. If you go ahead with construction, the fee is deducted from your project total.

items.q: Do I have to take time off work for design meetings?
items.a: No. Majestic holds its design meetings and consultations over Zoom at a time that works for you, so you can review material selections and renderings from home or the office. Once your design is approved, you receive a full construction spec and contract with no hidden costs.

Majestic's kitchen and bathroom pricing guides state that financing is available at 18% added to the total price. Packages are set at standard options, and estimates are done in person or from required photos you send. Problems found behind walls can add cost, so ask about them during your estimate.

Majestic gives an 18-month warranty on all of its labor. If an issue comes up, call the office and the team will take care of it. At final payment you also receive a full waiver of lien, so you know the subcontractors and suppliers on your job have been paid.

final_cta.text: Call the Majestic team in Sterling Heights or ask for your free estimate online.
